title: surroundingOpenings
description: Information for three dates: one before when the SP is open, one representing an opening or closure for the current date, and one after the provided date where the SP is open.  If there are no openings before or after a given date, then an opening object will be returned with the date immediately following, denoting a closure.

singleDayOpening.description: Opening information for a single day

date.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) that this object is describing openings for

allDay.description: If the service point is open or closed for the entire day

open.description: If the service point is open on this day

exceptional.description: If this opening (or closure) was the result of an exception

exceptionName.description: The name of an exception, if this day was affected by one

openings.description: A list of all the opening ranges of the service point on this day

singleDayOpeningRange.description: A time for a single opening range on a given day

startTime.description: The start time of this opening

endTime.description: The end time of this opening
